_about: Chat PR 1: golden pins of one chat turn on the web and the phone today (no behaviour change).
(copied into the test bundle by ios/scripts/build-engine.mjs). A later move into a shared reducer keeps every row green, unedited.
A value that is an object with both `web` and `phone` keys holds each client's value; `decision` names the survey's
D-number (chat-survey.md section 4) and `changedBy` the PR that may change it. Any other value is what both clients do.
A step's `line` is one NDJSON line from the server: an object (sent as JSON) or a string (sent as it is).
`pending` is the words under the conversation while the answer is written (null once the turn ends); `text` the answer
as it streams; `sources` the articles read so far. Keys a step leaves out are not checked at that step.
`clients` lists who runs a row (default both). Synthetic questions and answers only, no health values.

notPinnable.why: No pure seam on either client. Web: useChatState has no erase input; the transcript stays (survey D9). Phone: ChatView clears the transcript in an onChange of store.erasures (ChatView.swift) and send() drops the turn through its live() guard; both are view code. The shared reducer's `erased` event (chat PR 3/4) makes it pinnable.
The phone's 'no done line means cut off' rule and its words live in ChatView.send (private). The phone pins replay that one throw; the words in the cut-off rows are pinned, the detection is not.
ChatView.send turns a done line with an error into Failure.server(500, error); the pins replay that throw. ChatStreamEvent.parse's part (the error words) is pinned.

history._note: What goes back as history with the next question: how many earlier lines, all of them unfailed. The web sends the last 20 (chat-api.ts MAX_HISTORY_MESSAGES); the phone sends every unfailed line (the server cuts to 20, app/routes/api.chat.ts).
